question: What was the name of the political party formed by Subhash Chandra Bose after he left Congress party?
solution:
The correct answer is __**All India Forward Bloc**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **All India Forward Bloc** was the political party formed by Subhash Chandra Bose after he left the Indian National Congress.
 
• The party was established in **1939** with the aim to consolidate the political left and to bring about a radical change in the Indian freedom struggle.
 
• Subhash
